subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Amazon Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields`/`providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a provider request-field surface is a user-facing config contract and repository policy treats provider/config additions as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and safely merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without turning core config into a generic provider-body passthrough.

options.title: Add only typed beta support
options.body: Support a narrow Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long-context use while avoiding a general Converse body passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom beta config
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and require first-class provider support for each beta feature before OpenClaw sends it.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that validates and safely merges request fields, including `anthropic_beta`, without turning core config into a generic provider-body passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is provider/config contract policy, and steipete appears in recent extra-param and Anthropic 1M migration history.
